description: Trips by Distance with County Data is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Trips by Distance data with additional county transportation statistics. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 66 columns, among them MSA Name, State LON, Number of resident workers who commute to work in other counties, Number of resident workers who commute within county, Number of resident workers who work at home, Percent of resident workers who commute by transit. The portal shows 2020-06-10 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
